#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# FMAA Enterprise Infrastructure Setup Script
# Auto-generated setup untuk FMAA BDI Agent Enterprise Grade
# =============================================================================

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Logging function
log() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[$(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $1${NC}"
}

error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR] $1${NC}"
    exit 1
}

warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING] $1${NC}"
}

info() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO] $1${NC}"
}

# Banner
echo -e "${BLUE}"
cat << 'EOF'
╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                                               ║
║    🤖 FMAA BDI Agent Enterprise Infrastructure Setup          ║
║                                                               ║
║    ⚡ Zero-Cost • Multi-Cloud • Enterprise Grade              ║
║                                                               ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
EOF
echo -e "${NC}"

# Check prerequisites
check_prerequisites() {
    log "🔍 Checking prerequisites..."

    # Check Python
    if ! command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
        error "Python3 is required but not installed"
    fi

    # Check pip
    if ! command -v pip3 &> /dev/null; then
        error "pip3 is required but not installed"
    fi

    # Check git
    if ! command -v git &> /dev/null; then
        error "git is required but not installed"
    fi

    # Check node (optional)
    if ! command -v node &> /dev/null; then
        warn "Node.js not found - some features may be limited"
    fi

    # Check docker (optional)
    if ! command -v docker &> /dev/null; then
        warn "Docker not found - containerization features will be disabled"
    fi

    log "✅ Prerequisites check completed"
}

# Create project structure
create_structure() {
    log "📁 Creating FMAA Enterprise project structure..."

    # Execute Python structure generator
    python3 scripts/generate_structure.py

    log "✅ Project structure created successfully"
}

# Install dependencies
install_dependencies() {
    log "📦 Installing Python dependencies..."

    # Create virtual environment
    python3 -m venv venv
    source venv/bin/activate

    # Upgrade pip
    pip install --upgrade pip

    # Install requirements
    pip install -r requirements.txt

    log "✅ Dependencies installed successfully"
}

# Setup configuration
setup_config() {
    log "⚙️ Setting up configurations..."

    # Copy environment templates
    if [ ! -f ".env" ]; then
        cp configs/env.template .env
        warn "⚠️ Please update .env file with your configurations"
    fi

    # Setup cloud configurations
    if [ ! -d "configs/cloud" ]; then
        warn "⚠️ Please configure cloud credentials in configs/cloud/"
    fi

    log "✅ Configuration setup completed"
}

# Setup development environment
setup_dev() {
    log "🛠️ Setting up development environment..."

    # Install pre-commit hooks
    if command -v pre-commit &> /dev/null; then
        pre-commit install
    fi

    # Setup IDE configurations
    if [ -d ".vscode" ]; then
        info "VSCode configuration found"
    fi

    log "✅ Development environment setup completed"
}

# Run initial tests
run_tests() {
    log "🧪 Running initial tests..."

    # Activate virtual environment
    source venv/bin/activate

    # Run basic tests
    python -m pytest tests/unit/ -v

    log "✅ Initial tests completed"
}

# Main execution
main() {
    log "🚀 Starting FMAA Enterprise Infrastructure Setup..."

    check_prerequisites
    create_structure
    install_dependencies
    setup_config
    setup_dev
    run_tests

    echo -e "${GREEN}"
    cat << 'EOF'
╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                                               ║
║    ✅ FMAA Enterprise Infrastructure Setup Complete!          ║
║                                                               ║
║    Next Steps:                                                ║
║    1. Update .env file with your configurations               ║
║    2. Configure cloud credentials                             ║
║    3. Run: python core/bdi_master.py                          ║
║    4. Access dashboard: http://localhost:8080                 ║
║                                                               ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
EOF
    echo -e "${NC}"
}

# Execute main function
main "$@"
